announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This is a standard administrative filing confirming the outcome of the Annual General Meeting, which typically involves routine matters such as director re-election and auditor appointment rather than strategic shifts or capital raises.

announcements.headline: Clay Lake Drilling intersects extensive miner...
announcements.insight: Extensive mineral intersections at Clay Lake reinforce CDI's position as a high-grade gold producer in the prolific Yilgarn Craton, supporting valuation multiples relative to junior explorers and validating the strategic pivot toward core asset development.

announcements.headline: Final Results for the Year to 31 May 2026
announcements.insight: Final results for a junior explorer like CGNR are critical for validating the viability of its UK lithium projects amidst the current EV battery supply chain consolidation; strong reserve updates or production milestones here could trigger institutional interest, while weak metrics risk further dilution in a capital-intensive sector.
